chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said — and those (rulers) were mentioned in his presence along with the bad condition of the Shia under them —

So he said: 'I traveled with Abu Ja'far al-Mansur while he was in his royal procession, mounted on a horse with cavalry before him and cavalry behind him, while I was on a donkey at his side. He said to me: "O Abu Abdillah, it was (the case), and it is appropriate that you rejoice in what God has given us of power and opened for us of glory, and that you not inform the people that you and your Ahl al-Bayt are more deserving of this authority than us, so as to incite us against you and against them." He said: So I said, "Whoever has conveyed this to you from me has lied." He said to me: "Do you swear by what you say?" He said: So I said, "Indeed, people are like sorcerers — meaning they like to corrupt your heart against me, so do not give them access to your hearing. For we are more in need of you than you are of us." He said to me: "Do you remember the day you were asked whether we would have a kingdom, and you said: 'Yes, long, wide, and strong; and you will continue to have respite in your affair and comfort in your worldly life until you spill from us forbidden blood in a forbidden month in a forbidden city.'" I recognized that he had memorized the hadith. So I said: "Perhaps God (Mighty and Majestic) will spare you. For I did not single you out with this —"

— and it is merely a hadith I narrated. Then perhaps another from your household will be the one to do that. So he fell silent regarding me. When I returned to my residence, one of our followers came to me and said: 'May I be your ransom! By God, I saw you in Abu Ja'far's procession while you were on a donkey and he was on a horse, and he was looking down at you speaking to you as if you were beneath him. So I said to myself: This one is God's Proof upon creation and the master of this affair whom people follow, while that other one acts with injustice, kills the children of prophets, and sheds blood in the earth with what God does not love — and he is in his procession while you are on a donkey. So doubt entered me from that until I feared for my religion and myself.' He said: So I said: 'Had you seen those who were around me and before me and behind me and to my right and to my left from among the angels, you would have considered him contemptible and considered contemptible what he is in.' So he said: 'Now my heart has settled.' Then he said: 'Until when will these (tyrants) rule, or when will there be relief from them?' So I said: 'Do you not know that everything has a duration?' He said: 'Yes.' So I said: 'Will your knowing that this affair, when it comes, will be faster than the blink of an eye — benefit you? If you were to know their state with God (Mighty and Majestic) and how it is, you would hate them more intensely. And even if you strove, or all the people of the earth strove, to plunge them into the most severe state of sin they are in, they would not be able.'

has encompassed the lands, and you see the Quran has grown worn and old, and innovations have been introduced into it and it has been directed according to desires, and you see that religion has tipped over just as water tips over, and you see the people of falsehood have risen above the people of truth, and you see evil openly displayed with none forbidding it and its people excused, and you see immorality openly manifest with men satisfied with men and women with women, and you see the believer silent with his speech not accepted, and you see the immoral person lying without his lie and slander being refuted, and you see the young disrespecting the old, and you see family ties cut, and you see the one who boasts of immorality being laughed at and his speech not refuted, and you see the young boy giving what a woman gives, and you see women marrying women, and you see flattery has proliferated, and you see the man spending wealth in disobedience to God without being stopped or restrained, and you see the observer seeking refuge with God from what he sees the believer striving in, and you see the neighbor harming his neighbor with none to prevent him, and you see the disbeliever joyful at what he sees in the believer and gleeful at the corruption he sees on the earth, and you see wine drunk openly with those who do not fear God gathering over it, and you see the one commanding good humiliated, and you see the immoral person strong and praised in what God does not love, and you see the people of signs despised and those who love them despised, and you see the path of good cut off and the path of evil traversed, and you see the House of God abandoned

and commanded to be left, and you see the man say what he does not do, and you see men beautifying themselves for men and women for women, and you see the man whose livelihood comes from his backside and the woman whose livelihood comes from her private parts, and you see women taking up gatherings as men do, and you see effeminacy appearing among the children of al-Abbas openly displaying dyeing and combing as a woman combs for her husband, and they gave wealth to men for their private parts — men competing over a man and being jealous over him, and the wealthy being more honored than the believer, and usury openly practiced without censure, and women being praised for adultery, and you see the woman bribing her husband to marry men, and you see most people and the best of households being those who assist women in their immorality, and you see the believer grieved, despised, and humiliated, and you see innovations and adultery openly manifest, and you see people relying on false witnesses, and you see the forbidden made permissible and the permissible made forbidden, and you see religion based on personal opinion with the Book and its rulings abandoned, and you see the night offering no concealment from boldness against God, and you see the believer unable to denounce except in his heart, and you see great wealth spent in God's displeasure, and you see rulers bringing the people of disbelief close and distancing the people of good, and you see rulers accepting bribes in judgment, and you see governorship auctioned to the highest bidder, and you see women of close blood relations married and sufficed with, and you see a man killed on mere accusation and suspicion, and competing over a male man who gives himself and his wealth for it, and you see the man reproached for approaching women, and you see the man eating from his wife's earnings from immorality knowing it and persisting in it, and you see

the woman dominating her husband and doing what he does not desire and spending on her husband, and you see the man renting out his wife and slave-girl and accepting the lowest of food and drink, and you see false oaths by God widespread, and you see gambling openly manifest, and you see drink sold openly with none preventing it, and you see women giving themselves to people of disbelief, and you see entertainments openly displayed with people passing by without anyone preventing them and no one dares to prevent them, and you see the noble person humiliated by the one whose authority is feared, and you see those closest to the rulers are those who praise themselves by reviling us the Ahl al-Bayt, and you see those who love us falsely accused and their testimony not accepted, and you see false speech competed over, and you see the Quran heavy on people's ears to hear and light on people's ears to hear falsehood, and you see the neighbor honoring his neighbor out of fear of his tongue, and you see the prescribed punishments abandoned and caprice practiced in them, and you see mosques adorned, and you see the most truthful person among the people being the fabricator of lies, and you see evil openly manifest and striving with tale-bearing, and you see transgression spread, and you see backbiting considered pleasing with people congratulating each other over it, and you see hajj and jihad sought for other than God, and you see the ruler humiliating the believer before the disbeliever, and you see ruin prevailing over civilization, and you see the man's livelihood from short-measuring and short-weighing, and you see bloodshed taken lightly, and you see the man seeking leadership for worldly gain and making himself notorious through foul speech so he may be feared and affairs delegated to him, and you see salat treated with contempt, and you see the man with much wealth who has not paid zakat on it

since he owned it, and you see the dead exhumed from their graves, harmed, and their burial shrouds sold, and you see killing has increased, and you see the man retiring drunk at evening and waking drunk at morning without concern for what people are in, and you see animals copulated with, and you see animals tearing each other apart, and you see the man going out to his prayer place and returning with none of his garments upon him, and you see people's hearts hardened and their eyes dried and dhikr heavy upon them, and you see unlawful gain openly displayed and competed over, and you see the one who prays only praying to be seen by people, and you see the jurist seeking jurisprudence for other than religion seeking worldly life and leadership, and you see people following whoever prevails, and you see the seeker of the permissible criticized and reproached while the seeker of the forbidden is praised and glorified, and you see the two sacred sanctuaries with what God does not love being done in them with none preventing them and no one standing between them and ugly deeds, and you see musical instruments openly displayed in the two sanctuaries, and you see the man speaking some truth, commanding good, and forbidding evil, whereupon someone rises up to advise him privately saying, 'This obligation is lifted from you,' and you see people looking at one another and following the people of evil, and you see the path of good and its way empty with none traveling it, and you see the dead mocked at with no one alarmed for him, and you see every year more evil and innovation than the year before, and you see the creation and gatherings following only the wealthy, and you see the needy given something to be laughed at and shown mercy for other than God's sake, and you see signs in the sky with none alarmed by them, and you see people copulating as animals copulate with not

No one denounces a wrong out of fear of the people; and you see a man spending much in disobedience to God while withholding even a little in obedience to God; and you see filial impiety spread openly, parents treated with disrespect and considered the worst of people by their own children, while the child rejoices at their anger; and you see women dominating the sovereignty, seizing control of every affair so that nothing happens except what they wish; and you see a man's son slandering his own father, cursing his parents, and rejoicing at their death; and you see a man who, if a day passes without him committing a grave sin—whether immorality, cheating in measures or weights, fraud, or drinking an intoxicant—goes about dejected and sad, thinking his day was wasted; and you see the ruler hoarding food; and you see the wealth of blood-relatives divided through lies, gambled with, and used to purchase wine; and you see wine being used as medicine, prescribed for the sick, and sought as a cure; and you see people having abandoned commanding good and forbidding evil, abandoning it so completely that the obligation has been lifted from them; and you see the violent winds ignored; and you see the immoral exalted because people are in need of them; and you see a man outside obedience being heeded, feared, and avoided; and you see those who pray having their prayers cut off; and you see whoever devours orphans' wealth being praised; and you see judges ruling contrary to what God commanded; and you see rulers trusting liars; and you see the inheritance being given by rulers to the people of immorality and audacity against God, taken from it and left to them; and you see the sacred law sold through bribes; and you see blood money collected, then divided without being used for righteous ends; and you see mosques adorned with gold and silver, with praises inscribed in them; and you see people's trusts treated so lightly that trust has become a spoil and treachery a matter of pride; and you see prayer belittled so much that a man fails to pray at its proper time; and you see a Muslim woman treated with the same disrespect as one would treat a slave-girl; and you see alms not given except through intercession.

Alms are not given except through intercession; and you see people seeking wealth through adultery; and you see people considering the maintenance of family ties a charity bestowed upon them; and you see the prince criticizing his followers for prayer; and you see grants given in other than their rightful place; and you see those who professed to renounce worldly life approaching rulers out of greed; and you see the companions of the Messenger of God—peace and blessings upon him and his family—reviled and insulted while no one prevents this; and you see a man who loves his companion for [the companion's] lying; and you see all the gates of good closed and all the gates of evil wide open; and you see a man who fears God and is pious finding no one to help him in that; and you see doubts spread openly; and you see the lover of worldly life desiring a long life; and you see alms distributed only through intercession; and you see a man sharing in injustice with the people lest what he has in hand be taken; and you see prayer belittled; and you see a man who has much wealth but does not pay zakat on it, and every time someone walks with him, he struts more; and you see sacrificial animals slaughtered for other than God; and you see when a man commands what is good he is mocked, and when he forbids evil he is rebuffed. And what are you going to do, O Humran? So fear God and do not be of those who follow the leaders of misguidance, and do not be of those who incline toward them in a way that will harm you on the Day of Resurrection. And know, O Humran, that if you had lived in those times while upon the same righteous deeds you are upon today, and had kept yourself free of their audacity against God the Mighty and Majestic, know that God does not waste the reward of those who do good, and that God's mercy is near to those who do good.

key_terms.آخِر الزَّمَان: the end of times / the Last Era

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the end times according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq recounts his journey with the Abbasid caliph al-Mansur and his companion Humran, then delivers an extensive prophecy of the signs of the end times: widespread injustice, moral decay, abandonment of the Quran, violations of sacred law, and the obliteration of commanding good and forbidding evil. He concludes by urging Humran to maintain taqwa and righteous deeds.
